high.quote: He's got really good colours, orange-green is just very, very strong… You'll probably always play Master Yi over K'Sante. But I actually think he's low A. (translated from German)
[Ziggs] is as well for me tier two… I think he stays in tier two, 100 percent, right now.

low.quote: I'm not going to give something S tier until it's proved itself… I think Riven's gonna be the best legend of the set.

buffs.why: Spells with power costs she gets to ignore, and early units with the might her Vendetta deck lacked.
Two Mech upgrades: a Disarm unit that helps him win showdowns, and a sturdier four-cost Mech.
A draw engine at last, the thing her kit has lacked for a year.
More cards to hide, which is exactly what the scout wants.
Calm cards for holding a battlefield, plus Momentary Companion from the Chaos Hidden package.
A gear that works like a second legend ability each turn: two tokens, two battlefields to conquer.
A conquer-every-turn package, though the new Fury–Order legend, Mordekaiser, may take those cards.
A new champion unit for going first, and support for holding a battlefield.
The new Chaos Hidden cards, built for Evelynn, suit a legend who wants an empty hand at the end of her turn.
Siren's Song, which she can cast with the runes her ability readies.
Gold tokens that pay the power costs of the new Hidden cards, and a cute defensive synergy with Ziggs, Explosive.
